chunks: From him, from Yunus, from Ya'qub, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: For every month, an Umrah.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about performing Umrah every month?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar highlights the high status of Umrah in Shia jurisprudence, with Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advocating for its performance every month to maintain spiritual purity. While some scholars interpret this as a recommendation for frequent voluntary pilgrimage, others contextualize it within the broader tradition of seeking forgiveness and divine proximity through repeated acts of worship.
